summary: Recent updates to the Firefox browser's integration of **libwebrtc**, the technology behind real-time communication like video calls, have focused on improving the efficiency and reliability of video transmission. Notably, changes were made to prevent unnecessary signal interruptions in video streams by addressing the RTCRtpSender's handling of trackless senders, which enhances stability during calls. Additionally, the removal of redundant H.264 data before decoding helps optimize video performance. Other adjustments involved updating how video decoders and encoders are created, moving towards modern memory management practices that improve resource handling. Together, these enhancements aim to ensure smoother, more reliable video experiences for users during their online communications.
